description:
Remove a recheck from schedule_recheck before it fires (nothing was charged). One that fired can't be cancelled: already_ran with its audit_id.

Billing: free.

When to call: the user no longer wants it (to change prompts or date: cancel, then schedule again).

Returns { recheck_id, cancelled: true, already_cancelled? } or { error: not_found | already_ran | not_pending }.
name: cancel_recheck
title: Cancel a scheduled recheck before it runs
